request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex, including on-chain payments and card infrastructure plus Intersect administration.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, consisting of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 and 115,385 ada for an Intersect Budget Administration fee.

Wirex proposes full-stack, open-source payments infrastructure for Cardano that includes smart contracts, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet and API ecosystem components.

The proposal says the infrastructure will connect Cardano to banking rails, stablecoin systems, wallet interfaces, and Visa card issuance linked to on-chain balances for spending at millions of merchants.
Wirex is claimed to have 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, over $20 billion in transaction volume, and Visa Principal Member experience.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and references voting, documentation, audited results, and audit report sources.
The requested withdrawal is asserted not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission, with a governance-action reference provided.

Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are described as being provided through Intersect, third parties, and the Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework.
The proposal states Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.
The proposal provides TRSC and PSSC addresses, role thresholds, named oversight committee entities, and a public dashboard for tracking and on-chain verification of withdrawn funds.
The proposal claims the project will increase Cardano utility, transaction volume, user growth, institutional participation, and real-world economic activity on-chain.

summary: The document describes a 3,961,538 ada treasury withdrawal administered by Intersect for Wirex payment infrastructure, with a detailed budget, treasury-management process, governance references, and several high-impact adoption claims that are mostly asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
